phases.official_behavior: Form controls are editable subject to dependency rules. Validate is enabled; Print and Submit / Final Copy are disabled.
Save runs only the three-check initialValidateBeforeSave preflight, serializes current form controls to plaintext savefile XML, updates the profile, and leaves the return editable.
After ordered Validate checks pass, editable controls are disabled, Edit/Print/Submit-Final Copy are enabled, and the current dynamic ATC row count is stored.
Submit / Final Copy first checks existing versions, then asks for Internet/email confirmation. It does not expose a separate ordinary offline-final action.
When the connection probe fails after confirmation, txtFinalFlag is set to 3 and saveEncryptedProfile produces an encrypted IAF_RDO_Copy artifact through saveXML(true).
Enrollment/credential UI collects online state, creates the encrypted return, and invokes RenameAndSendFile.
Transport return code 0 sets txtFinalFlag=1, updates the saved return, shows the success message, and displays payment options.
A nonzero transport code or exception sets txtFinalFlag=2, updates the saved return, and permits the resend branch.

prerequisites: A fully validated state is required before Submit / Final Copy becomes enabled.
Item 12 must be nonblank under Validate, but the official implementation does not validate email syntax.
The submission-first path asks the user to ensure Internet access; a failed connection probe falls back to encrypted offline-final generation.
An existing finalized non-amended return requires selecting Amended Return Yes before Save, Final Copy, or Submit.
